title: UIQS Validation — Domain E Seed Certification Wave 1
purpose: Apply S306 UIQS methodology to validate current and projected post-remediation user-item quality scores for all 38 Domain E seeds.
methodology: S306 UIQS v1.0 — 5-dimension scoring: Stem Clarity (20), Distractor Plausibility (20), ExplanationCorrect Depth (25), ExplanationWrong Educational Value (25), Metadata Calibration (10). Max score: 100.

stem_clarity.status: GOOD — stems are clear, well-written, scenario-grounded

distractor_plausibility.status: WEAK — distractors are plausible but generic, not misconception-guided

ec_depth.status: WEAK — average 200-280 chars, lacking business interpretation and COSO citations

ew_educational_value.status: CRITICAL — 46% of slots empty (53/114), pulling score significantly down

distractor_plausibility.note: Improved with choice-specific EW providing misconception anchoring

ec_depth.note: EC enriched to 400+ chars with COSO citations and business interpretation

ew_educational_value.note: All 53 empty slots filled + 8 DL-013 slots replaced with genuine explanations

metadata_calibration.note: All 26 CL/Difficulty mismatches resolved in Pass 2

projected_post_remediation.post_remediation_note: UIQS of 88.5 positions seeds at B+ grade — slightly below Pack B benchmark (92-95, A range) but well above the minimum certification threshold (70, C+).

best_current.note: Strong EC, well-calibrated Apply-level, excellent EW_C and EW_D — only needs EW_B

worst_current.note: Weakest EC (144 chars, 3/10), DL-013 boilerplate in 2 slots, 1 empty slot

most_improved_projected.note: From worst-covered to certifiable — requires full EW rewrite + EC rewrite

best_projected.note: Already exemplary EC — only needs 2 EW fills to reach A-grade range

domain_e_uiqs_trajectory.rationale: Domain E UIQS declines from A- to B when legacy seeds at lower quality (projected 88.5 avg) are averaged against replacement items (90-93 range). This dilution is expected and acceptable — replacement items are high-quality new content, seeds are remediated legacy content.

certification_impact.uiqs_gate: PASS — all 38 seeds projected above 70 (C+) threshold post-remediation
certification_impact.blocking_note: UIQS is an informative metric, not a certification gate. Items may certify below UIQS 70 if content is CAQS-compliant, but all 38 seeds are projected above 70.
